FROST FOG ALONG THE FLOOR: a low layer of frost fog lying along the floor and hiding the feet of everything, the air above it clear and bright
FOG LAYER HALFWAY UP: fog hanging in one flat, even layer halfway up the chamber, the air above it perfectly still and the air below softly hidden
PALE HAZE AT THE FAR END: a soft cold haze settling at the far end of the chamber, softening the distance into pale, quiet bands of blue and white
FOG IN THE LOWEST CORNER: frost fog pooling in the lowest corner and staying there, content and unhurried, thick and pillowy and gently glowing
FROST VEIL NEAR THE OPENING: a thin veil of frost fog leaning softly toward an opening, drawn by the faintest breath of air from beyond
STEPPED GREY-BLUE HAZE: a soft grey-blue haze layering the depth of the chamber into flat, dreamy steps, each one a little paler than the last
SLOWLY TURNING ICE CRYSTALS: fine ice crystals turning slowly in the light and glittering as they pass, each one catching a bright spark before drifting on
ICE DUST FALLING PAST THE EDGE: a slow fall of ice dust drifting past the near edge, each mote catching the light for just a moment before continuing down
BRIGHT MOTES ALMOST STILL: bright motes of ice hanging almost still in the cold air, trembling faintly as though deciding whether to rise or fall
ICE DUST ON EVERY LEDGE: ice dust settling soft and even on every ledge, laying down a fine, glittering coat as quietly and carefully as a gift
CRYSTALS DRIFTING THROUGH THE CHAMBER: a scatter of glittering crystals drifting down through the whole chamber, filling the air with tiny, wandering points of light
MIST STANDING OVER THE WATER: a soft white breath of mist standing over the open water and thinning as it lifts, fading to nothing well before the top
MIST LOW ON THE POOL: mist lying low and still on a pool, resting there in one even, unbroken layer, patient and perfectly at ease
PALE VEIL LIFTING OFF MELTWATER: a pale veil lifting off the meltwater and fading as it rises, dissolving into the cold air in soft, gradual wisps
WARM MIST AROUND THE RIM: warm mist clinging gently around the rim of a pool, curling just slightly inward as it thins and blends into the chill above
WHITE BLOOM OVER THE LOWEST SHELF: a gentle white bloom of mist hanging over the lowest shelf, soft and round-edged and quietly luminous in the pale chamber light
CRISP CLEAR COLD AIR: the air so clear and cold that every far detail is crisp and hard-edged, the whole chamber laid out sharp and bright and readable
STILL GLASSY CLARITY: a still glassy clarity reaching all the way to the deep end, every surface sharp and every colour clean and exact
COLD CLEAN AIR THROUGHOUT: cold clean air filling the chamber evenly, the far wall as sharp and present as the near one, nothing softened or lost
AIR WASHED PERFECTLY CLEAR: the air washed clean throughout, every band and layer in the ice perfectly readable from one end of the chamber to the other
HARD BRIGHT CLARITY: a hard bright clarity carrying all the way to the far wall, the whole space open and legible and pleasingly exact
FLAKES DRIFTING IN FROM ABOVE: a few flakes drifting in through the opening above and settling on the floor, each one arriving gently and staying right where it lands
THIN POWDER THROUGH A CRACK: a thin fall of powder coming down through a crack in the ceiling and gathering in a small, soft heap directly below
POWDER LIFTING OFF A LEDGE: loose powder lifting off a ledge and then settling again, rising just a little before deciding to come back down and rest
LIGHT SNOW THROUGH THE UPPER DARK: a light dust of snow drifting down through the upper dark, falling slowly and evenly until it reaches the quiet air below
